scope: Future imperfect-competition assessments; adapt graph/table proportion to other units rather than mechanically applying it.
misconceptions: MR = MC selects output; demand selects price.
Zero economic profit does not imply allocative or productive efficiency.
Natural monopoly is defined by relevant-range cost economies, not merely by ownership or a patent.
Fair-return P = ATC and efficient P = MC are different targets.
A subsidy can change a rival action and reduce the recipient equilibrium profit.
